newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens at record high on Wall Street surge.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens at record high on Wall Street surge.

text.p: British shares opened at an all-time high on Tuesday, taking their lead from last night's U.S. market surge which took the Dow index to a record close above the 6,000 level.
London's FTSE 100 index was up 6.9 points at 4,045.6 by 0755 GMT, after slipping from its opening of 4,050.0. The previous intraday high of 4,046.8 was surpassed in pre-market trade.
"There's no doubt we're going higher today," said one dealer. "But I don't expect anything too dramatic."
Investors were likely to remain cautious ahead of key economic data both here and in the U.S. later in the week. UK gilts were firm but subdued ahead of an auction later today.
